commit.message:
fix: show job logs if there are any (#14263)

When the latest attempt of a job is waiting for a runner, no task for that job exists yet. In that case, Forgejo would not display any logs — not for the current attempt, but also not for any previous attempt.

Resolves https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/12626, after https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/12779 only fixed the missing attempt selector.
